# researchurgy

> LGD-aligned term-registration asset. Four-angle score: LGD 82/100 (REG 80/TRUST 80/SAFE 100/MACH 66).
> The engineering of research as a reproducible method: evidence grading, cross-validation, replication.

## What this is

`researchurgy` is a **term-registration** claim in the Lifecycle Governance Doctrine (LGD) naming system, in the meta-layer-creation family (-urgy). It registers the term *researchurgy* — the engineering of research as a reproducible method rather than ad-hoc effort.

Method spine: problem definition → hypothesis → channels → evidence grading → cross-validation → synthesis → replication → meta-review.
